title: WALLS CAST LAMP SHADOWS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. Lamplight used to pass straight through walls: a lamp on one side of a wall lit the floor on the other side just as much. Now, at LIGHTING HIGH, every lamp lights only what it can reach: walls throw shadows away from the lamp, light spills through doorways and window gaps, and the face of a wall turned toward a lamp is lit while the floor behind it is dark. A little light is kept in the shadows so nothing goes pitch black, and a door you open or a wall you break lets the light through. Shadows are only drawn, never used by the game: being in a lamp shadow does not hide you any better than before. STANDARD keeps the coloured light without shadows, and CLASSIC is the old look.
now: At LIGHTING HIGH walls now cast lamp shadows, light spills through doorways, and opened doors and broken walls let it through.
